components.heading: Boundaries of Monroe School overlay district.
components.text: The boundaries of the Monroe School overlay district shall be drawn so as to include all lands petitioned for inclusion in the district, and shall apply to all buildings, structures, sites, and land areas within the established boundaries. (Ord. 20596 § 2, 9-9-25.)
